about: On the file-set definition: views are custom interfaces with their own logic for a kind of file (every SKILL.md gets one skill interface); shared templates are possible but not required. The changelog should be JSON so changes can later be followed by task, with the input, description and what logic changed. Asks whether schema.json is already covered by the examples or is additional.
changes_when: Never in the owner's words; only its answer and what it was processed into are added once its knowledge is placed.

update_with.how: Keep its row (summary, categories, processed_into, answered) the same as this file.
